summary: Confirmed all P0/P1 protocol and DOM defects in revision-01.md against protocol-fixtures.json and source code (noting Google's real 'Verify your account to continue.' reply is misclassified as 'returned'), and independently identified and reproduced 10 additional defect classes including 3 new P0 (post-click submit_uncertain wipeout causing double-submit, stale assistant/wrong-tab status contamination and journal URL corruption, detached bodyClone.innerText script/hidden-DOM leakage) and 4 new P1 (symlink escape and arbitrary file overwrite in collector/journal, collector scope blindness and unsanitized tests secret leakage, additional uncertain-send/restart double-submit gaps, and GitHub MCP error misclassification and directory/symlink/JSON-mangling file parser bugs).

tests.note: Existing unit tests mock minis-browser-use and minis-mcp-cli; no live Minis binaries exist in the cloud audit environment and no live tests were faked. Independent non-network reproduction probes were executed directly against bridge/minis_gemini_bridge.py and orchestration/bootstrap/protocol-fixtures.json.

confirmed_revision_01_findings.summary: BrowserUseClient calls nonexistent subcommands/flags (tabs, open, navigate without --url, eval without --script), and all 5 execute_js scripts omit top-level return inside the async wrapper.
confirmed_revision_01_findings.evidence: Probe 1 captured argvs ['minis-browser-use','tabs'], ['minis-browser-use','open',url], ['minis-browser-use','navigate','--tab-id','4',url], ['minis-browser-use','eval','--tab-id','4','return 1;'] and confirmed all 5 JS scripts omit leading 'return '.

confirmed_revision_01_findings.summary: Fails to parse JSON in data.text with trailing '\n  tab_id: N', ignores data.page_url, and fails to treat data.success=false as an error.
confirmed_revision_01_findings.evidence: Probe 1 against browser-object-real.json dropped '{"probe":true}' into human_text; probe with data.success=false did not raise BrowserError.

confirmed_revision_01_findings.summary: Regex at line 988 extracts tab_id='Tab' instead of '4' from browser-tabs-real.json and cannot parse new_tab 'Opened new tab N at URL'.
Uses wrong project URL (/remote/projects/<id>) and wrong default model ('Pro' vs 'Gemini 4 Neon High'); _verify_pre_send_ui allows visible_text[:1000] to spoof both project and model checks.
confirmed_revision_01_findings.evidence: Probe 2 passed _verify_pre_send_ui with project_text='WRONG-PROJECT' and model_text='Gemini Ultra Paid Credits' when visible_text mentioned the project ID and 'Pro'.

confirmed_revision_01_findings.summary: DOM selectors mismatch live Antigravity UI, and build_status_inspect_js line 1153 embeds literal \x08 backspace bytes in the stop/cancel regex via non-raw f-string '\b'.
confirmed_revision_01_findings.evidence: Probe 1 confirmed '\x08' in build_status_inspect_js('probe') is True.

confirmed_revision_01_findings.summary: Misses Google's real 'Verify your account to continue.' error (actively misclassifying it as 'returned' exit 0 when in assistant_messages) while full visible_text regex scanning causes false-positive blocks on legitimate replies mentioning error/auth keywords.
confirmed_revision_01_findings.evidence: Probe 4: 'Verify your account to continue.' -> classification='returned'; legitimate reply mentioning 'sign in, rate limit, and network error' -> classification='blocked' (identity_or_verification).

additional_findings.summary: Non-structured or tab-id-suffixed post-click response resets state='blocked_before_send' and send_initiated=False, wiping submit_uncertain and allowing automatic double-submit on the next submit call.
additional_findings.evidence: Probe 3: after btn.click() returned JSON + '\n  tab_id: 4', journal reset to state='blocked_before_send', send_initiated=False, and a second submit called btn.click() again (total_click_send_calls=2).

additional_findings.summary: Stale assistant messages trigger 'returned' even when marker_in_conversation=False or without DOM turn ordering after the user prompt; prefixed prompt echoes bypass echo filter; cmd_status falls back to another open project tab without navigating and overwrites journal conversation_url; --contract + --attempt uses the contract's attempt marker instead of the requested attempt's marker.
additional_findings.evidence: Probe 4: stale_reply_without_marker='returned', prefixed_echo='returned', cmd_status inspected conv-bbb and overwrote attempt 2 conversation_url from conv-aaa to conv-bbb while searching for attempt 1's task_marker.

additional_findings.summary: Reading innerText on detached document.body.cloneNode(true) falls back to textContent in WebKit/Chromium, leaking <script>, <style>, hydration JSON, and hidden modal templates into visible_text and marker_in_conversation; whole-body scan also matches sidebar chat titles.
additional_findings.evidence: Static inspection of lines 1107-1111 and 1164-1168: bodyClone is never connected to the DOM before reading bodyClone.innerText, and marker_in_conversation checks nonEditorText.includes(marker) across the whole cloned body.

additional_findings.summary: Symlink escape and arbitrary file overwrite: _safe_write_collected_file allows collect_root symlink escape, follows internal target symlinks to overwrite result.json, and writes predictable .tmp.<pid> files without O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW; JobJournal.save lacks symlink checks, fsync, and file locking.

Collector never inspects git diff/tree on job_branch for unauthorized out-of-scope file modifications; attempt>1 submit only checks prior snapshot existence (not hash) and collect ignores prior snapshots; result.json['tests'] is echoed to stdout without sanitize_text() or size bounds; self-referential commit SHA fields are not rejected.
additional_findings.evidence: Probe 7: collect exited 0 (collected_not_accepted) despite '.github/workflows/evil.yml' on job_branch and 'final_commit_sha' in result.json, leaked 'ghp_1234567890abcdef12345678' verbatim in stdout tests, and attempt-2 submit accepted tampered attempt-01/task.json.

additional_findings.summary: Post-send marks submitted on running=True (including generic [aria-busy='true']) without marker_in_conversation; pre-send ignores marker_in_conversation=True; fresh state-dir with existing remote attempt-01 snapshot double-submits while agent is running; submit_uncertain reconciles only a single tab.
additional_findings.evidence: Probe 5: post-send running=True with marker_in_conversation=False returned exit 0 status='submitted'; Probe 3: pre-send marker_in_conversation=True still clicked send; Probe 9: fresh state-dir with existing remote snapshot submitted again (clicks=1).

additional_findings.summary: _raise_classified_mcp_error maps any 'not found' error (including missing MCP tool/server/repo) to McpNotFoundError swallowed as None; extract_file_text_from_mcp_envelope accepts directory JSON lists and git symlinks as file text, corrupts/rejects valid JSON artifacts with content/sha/path or type=dir keys, and returns status text when data.success=false.

validate_snapshot_matches_contract accepts missing contract_sha256 and tampered task_snapshot_path/result_snapshot_path; load_and_validate_contract accepts duplicate JSON keys; attempt 1 does not check if task_snapshot_path already exists on base_branch before create_file_immutable.
additional_findings.evidence: Probe 7: snapshot omitting contract_sha256 with result_snapshot_path='evil/hijacked_result.json' passed; Probe 9: duplicate 'goal' key silently accepted.

additional_findings.summary: Case-sensitive 'jobs' check allows 'Jobs/...' and case-duplicate paths; file/dir prefix collision ['src/a','src/a/b.py'] causes unhandled FileExistsError crash; collect does not clean stale files on re-collect; --tab-id is unvalidated (allows '--json' flag injection); validate_official_url allows non-default ports, empty-user '@', and '/remote/../signin'; journal leaks 'tab_id: 4' via human_text evidence.
additional_findings.evidence: Probes 4, 8, 9 reproduced all six conditions: case_insensitive_jobs_bypass_accepted, prefix_collision_unhandled_oserror='FileExistsError', tab_id_unvalidated_argvs with '--json', bad_urls_accepted (3/3), journal_contains_leaked_tab_id_4=True.

additional_findings.summary: WORKFLOW.md still cites outdated URL/Pro model assumptions, and protocol-fixtures.json contains no live minis-mcp-cli fixtures.

risks: Real minis-mcp-cli CLI invocation syntax, GitHub MCP tool/parameter names (perPage vs per_page, ref vs branch, from_branch), create_or_update_file overwrite semantics when sha is omitted, and actual MCP response envelopes remain unverified on iOS Minis.
Live Antigravity DOM selectors, ClipboardEvent paste fidelity, innerText newline normalization, and Cancel button visibility require live Minis verification after remediating R1-R6 and A1-A9.
iOS Minis app suspension/filesystem semantics (APFS case-insensitivity, non-fsynced journal rename, concurrent submit races) remain unverified and hazardous until A4 and A9 are fixed.
